Protein Food

Maitake Mushroom

About This Entry

Maitake forms frilly clusters — roasted or pan-fried with garlic. Forest-floor umami pairs with Pinot Noir, Nebbiolo, and earthy whites.

Beginner Guide

Also called hen of the woods; do not confuse with chicken of the woods (Laetiporus).

FAQ

What is Maitake Mushroom?
Also called hen of the woods; do not confuse with chicken of the woods (Laetiporus).
How should Maitake Mushroom be prepared for pairing-friendly dishes?
High-heat sear or roast develops umami; avoid waterlogged cooking. Wine pairing follows butter, garlic, and sauce context.
